text:
maria: Heads up — Healix (private deployment) just opened a security escalation. They say they can see patient IDs in logs that appear to have been accessed by a support service account. They pasted a snippet below and asked for an immediate assurance that there's no cross-tenant data exposure.

maria: ```
2026-03-19T14:05:11Z request_id=abc123 tenant=healix action=log_read principal=serviceAccount:support-svc@redwood resource=/var/logs/telemetry/2026/03/19.log line=452 data="user_id=patient_42"
2026-03-19T14:05:12Z request_id=abc124 tenant=other-corp action=log_read principal=serviceAccount:support-svc@redwood resource=/var/logs/telemetry/2026/03/19.log line=120 data="user_id=patient_42"
```

kevin: Can you confirm the time window they care about? Also need request IDs and any ticket link. We'll pull audit and KMS decrypt events.

maria: They reported the window 2026-03-19T14:05:10Z -> 2026-03-19T14:17:30Z. Ticket HEALIX-5234 included the snippet and a screencap. They say support-svc should not be able to read logs from other-tenants.

sec-bot: Alert: service-account token created: support-svc@redwood by ops-jane at 2026-03-19T13:58:09Z (ephemeral 30m).

diana: Containment actions — rotate tokens for support-svc, revoke any active sessions, and disable any cross-tenant routing for support tooling until we confirm. Also pull audit logs S3 path for healix and other-corp for that window.

sam: Running audit pull now: `pull-audit --tenant healix --from "2026-03-19T14:00" --to "2026-03-19T14:30" --out /tmp/healix-audit.json` — will gpg and upload to incident bucket.

maria: Customer asked whether KMS decrypts were performed by our control plane or by the customer. They want proof. Don't send raw PII — send hashed evidence.

kevin: Quick check of KMS logs: decrypt events for key=projects/redwood/keys/tenant-healix-key at 2026-03-19T14:05:11 show principal=serviceAccount:support-svc@redwood.internal and origin=control-plane. Need to verify whether that was triggered by a support session or by mis-scoped RBAC.

diana: If support-svc used a delegated session created during an escalation, that might explain it, but it should have been scoped to healix only. We need IAM grant history.

maria: I've marked this P1 and looped in AE. HEALIX wants an initial response within 2 hours. @kevin @diana please confirm next steps.

kevin: Running IAM history: `/usr/local/bin/run-iam-audit --tenant healix --since 2026-03-12 --out /tmp/iam-change.json` — will correlate grants with token creation.

sam: Audit pull completed and uploaded to `s3://redwood-incident-archive/healix/1789990001/audit.json.gpg`. Shared link to ticket.

maria: I rotated support-svc token and temporarily removed its ability to assume the `tenant-log-reader` role for all private deployments. Notifying oncall. Does that impact active support sessions?

diana: That's expected. If undoable impacts exist, we'll restore minimal scoped access after manual approval. For now containment first.

kevin: Preliminary finding: RBAC change at 2026-03-19T13:57:45 by user=ops-jane added `support-admin` to group `support-rotations` with global scope for 30m. That matches the service-account token creation time. Likely mis-scoped temporary grant.

maria: @ops-jane can you confirm the change and the reason?

ops-jane: I approved a short-lived escalation earlier for another customer and assumed the grant would be tenant-scoped. Looks like the UI allowed global scope and I didn't catch it. My mistake — I'm opening a PR to restrict the default scope and will follow up with a postmortem.

diana: OK treating this as misconfiguration rather than malicious activity for now. Next actions (owners):
1) kevin — verify KMS decrypt provenance and produce signed event list (include event IDs, origin services).
2) sam — provide full redacted audit logs for both tenants in the window.
3) diana — craft customer communication (redacted evidence + remediation steps) and set up call.
4) ops-jane — fix RBAC UI/validation and backfill policy to prevent global-scoped temp grants.

maria: I'll create the incident doc and set initial customer note SLA 24h for full writeup. Sec team, we need a short internal timeline for the postmortem.

sec-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-178999001 (severity P1)

maria: Thanks all. I'll update HEALIX-5234 with next steps: redacted evidence, containment actions taken (token rotation, revoke, disable cross-tenant), and offer a bridge. Will follow up with postmortem once we have the RBAC audit. :thumbsup:
